description_en: Downgrades the virtual IP address (VIP) access of a specific instance during the disaster recovery of multiple instances. Only Enterprise Platinum Edition instances support this operation. To call the operation, you must submit a ticket
description_zh: 多实例容灾降级，该接口作用是降级其中某个实例的公网VIP接入，目前只支持铂金版实例，需要提交工单申请
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt disaster-downgrade --instance-id mqtt-cn-xxx --downgrade-instance-id mqtt-cn-xxxx --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisasterDowngrade

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的 ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ApsaraMQ for MQTT instance for which you want to downgrade the VIP access
parameters.name: downgrade_instance_id

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial. This parameter is returned only if Resource Access Management (RAM) permission verification failed
AccessDeniedDetail.description_zh: 访问被拒绝详细信息；只有RAM校验失败才会返回此字段

Code.description_en: The response code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful. Other status codes indicate that the request failed. For information about error codes, see Error codes
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码：200：表示成功。                                 其它：表示错误码。错误码详情，请参见错误码

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values: true and false
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true：调用成功。                                 false：调用失败
